purpose: Durable encrypted Sign in with Apple refresh-grant lifecycle, including pending unbound authorizations that still require later revocation if abandoned.

columns.name: apple_auth_grant_ref
columns.meaning: Stable DANTE row ref for the Apple grant lifecycle.

columns.name: external_identity_ref
columns.meaning: Bound Apple ExternalIdentity after Account create/link succeeds.
columns.value_contract: May be null while the grant is pending/unbound.

columns.name: subject
columns.meaning: Apple subject whose grant is retained.

columns.name: client_id
columns.meaning: Apple Services ID/client audience under which the refresh grant was issued.

columns.name: refresh_token_ciphertext
columns.meaning: Application-layer AEAD ciphertext of the Apple refresh token.
columns.value_contract: Never plaintext; present until confirmed revocation and bounded to 16 KiB.

columns.name: refresh_token_nonce
columns.value_contract: Exactly 12 bytes when token material is present.

columns.name: encryption_key_id
columns.meaning: Identifier of the external application encryption key used for ciphertext.
columns.value_contract: No key material; trimmed non-empty max 128 when present.

columns.name: pending_expires_at
columns.meaning: Deadline for an unbound pending grant to become active before revocation reconciliation.
columns.value_contract: Present only while pending; <=30 minutes after creation.

columns.name: revocation_requested_at
columns.meaning: Instant DANTE committed local revocation and scheduled provider revocation.

columns.name: revoked_at
columns.meaning: Instant provider revocation was confirmed or authoritative provider revocation was reconciled.

foreign_keys.name: fk_apple_auth_grant_external_identity_subject
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: When bound, require the grant to reference the exact same Apple issuer+subject lifetime identity rather than only an arbitrary ExternalIdentity row.

unique_constraints.name: uq_apple_auth_grant_issuer_subject
unique_constraints.reason: One durable grant lifecycle per Apple subject.

unique_constraints.name: uq_apple_auth_grant_external_identity_ref
unique_constraints.reason: At most one Apple grant row can bind to an ExternalIdentity.

unique_constraints.name: uq_apple_auth_grant_ref_issuer_subject
unique_constraints.reason: Expose the exact grant+provider-subject tuple as a declarative FK target for pending link/enrollment state.

check_constraints.name: ck_apple_auth_grant_issuer
check_constraints.reason: Grant rows are Apple-specific by design.

check_constraints.name: ck_apple_auth_grant_client_id
check_constraints.reason: Persist exact bounded Apple audience context.

check_constraints.name: ck_apple_auth_grant_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: finite ordered lifecycle timestamps; pending expiry <=30 minutes

check_constraints.name: ck_apple_auth_grant_ciphertext
check_constraints.reason: Bound encrypted token material while permitting null after revocation.

check_constraints.name: ck_apple_auth_grant_encryption_key_id
check_constraints.expression_contract: key id null or trimmed non-empty <=128
check_constraints.reason: Persist key identity without key material.

check_constraints.name: ck_apple_auth_grant_state
check_constraints.reason: Make pending, active, revocation_pending and revoked states mutually coherent and clear secret material after confirmed revocation.

indexes.name: uq_apple_auth_grant_external_identity_ref
indexes.reason: One grant per bound external identity.

indexes.name: ix_apple_auth_grant_pending_expires_at
indexes.reason: Direct bounded cleanup/revocation scan for abandoned pending grants.

state_history.current_binding: Tracks the current server-side Apple authorization grant lifecycle for one issuer+subject.
state_history.chronology: pending -> active or revocation_pending -> revoked; active may enter revocation_pending.
state_history.immutability_policy: issuer, subject, client_id and row identity remain stable; token ciphertext may rotate only through reviewed grant reconciliation and is cleared at revoked.

lifecycle.retention: Durable while authorization lifecycle or revocation evidence is needed; revoked row remains without token secret material.
lifecycle.redaction: Encrypted token fields, subject and client context are security-sensitive; plaintext token is never persisted.

obligations: M5 real PostgreSQL Apple grant state, encrypted-secret nulling, exact issuer+subject binding and exact ACL proof
